title.narrative: Advancing Disability Inclusion through Knowledge and Local Action

description.narrative:
This workplan will advance disability inclusion and gender equality through three connected components: global knowledge development, OPD-led local action, and practical pilots on inclusive cities and accessible learning environments.
It will support the conceptual development of a UNESCO Global Disability Knowledge Hub through baseline mapping of UNESCO’s disability inclusion work and an international expert meeting with experts, policymakers and OPD representatives.
It will also establish a small grant scheme for OPDs in China and Mongolia to support local disability inclusion initiatives, such as accessibility actions, disability equality awareness, inclusive education, community participation, mentorship and caregiver support, with a strong gender perspective.
Building on the GDF programme outcome, ongoing work and country priorities, the workplan will further support a Youth for Inclusive Cities and Accessible Learning Environments pilot. This may include youth-led accessibility assessments, inclusive early childhood education, MIL, digital storytelling, and accessibility of educational, cultural and community spaces, with possible technical inputs from Japan and the Republic of Korea.
Across all components, the workplan will promote meaningful participation of persons with disabilities and OPDs, accessibility, reasonable accommodation and gender equality.
